messages:
Aisha (Customer Success): FYI we just received a high-severity ticket. Customer C-8421 says documentation generation pipelines returned much shorter/less actionable content after the latest draft model change. They noticed it right after the canary.

Ben (Support): Posted the repro they sent. They included a curl and two failing examples. Repro curl (anon):\n`````\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \\\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-draft-2.1","input":"Describe how to implement refresh token rotation for single-page apps, list pitfalls.","max_tokens":350}'\n`````\nThey said previous model gave numbered steps and HTTP snippets; new behavior is terse bullet text only.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Quick note: we enabled the draft speculative sampler in rwd-draft-2.1 to cut latency tail. Speculative flow accepts early tokens when a confidence heuristic is met — that can bias towards shorter, higher-probability continuations. Worth checking.

Clara (Eng-Runtime): Rollout timeline: canary started 2026-03-09T21:50Z at 10%, ramped to 100% by 22:07Z. Runtime flag flipped: `speculative_sampling=true`, `speculative_threshold=0.82`. I have org-level override machinery available.

Eli (Oncall): Measured p95 improvements after the flag: ~12% lower p95 on generation endpoints across the board. But if quality regressions are real we need to weigh tradeoffs.

Ben (Support): Example from customer (redacted):\nInput: "List the steps to validate OAuth2 authorization code flow end-to-end for a web app."\nOld output: 7 numbered steps incl. PKCE, state param handling, server-side token exchange, rotation, storage, revocation checks, sample requests.\nNew output (rwd-draft-2.1): "Use PKCE, check state, exchange code for tokens. Rotate and store tokens safely."\nCustomer: "We lost the stepwise guidance and example requests. This breaks our downstream docs generator."

Aisha (Customer Success): Customer marked this high-impact; they paused some automation. Want either a revert or an org-specific toggle. Asking for ETA.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Diagnostic checklist I recommend:\n- Run the same prompt set against rwd-stable-2.0, rwd-draft-2.1 with speculative on, and rwd-draft-2.1 with speculative off.\n- Measure completion length, token probability entropy, and a simple constraint coverage heuristic (e.g., presence of numbered steps, presence of code samples).\n- Try increasing `speculative_threshold` to 0.95 and/or reduce `speculative_prefix_len` to 1 to see if verbosity returns.

Clara (Eng-Runtime): Org toggle options:\n1) Global rollback to rwd-stable-2.0 -> ~5-10min, will cause routing handover.\n2) Per-org override to disable speculative sampling for C-8421 -> ~20-60s, no global disruption.\nI can deploy override now if we want.

Marta (Product): Recommend per-org override first to minimize impact. We'll follow up with analysis and a communication plan. Draft message: "We're applying an org-level setting to restore prior generation behavior for your traffic while we investigate. No action needed on your side." Thoughts?

Eli (Oncall): If we toggle org override, capture metrics before/after: p95 latency and our quality heuristics on their sample corpus. Also capture traffic logs to confirm routing.

Ben (Support): Customer prefers revert if it's faster, but is ok with org toggle if quicker. I'll tell them we can flip a toggle in <2min and then run a deeper RCA.

Clara (Eng-Runtime): Done: applied org override for C-8421 at 1779123953. Flag now `speculative_sampling=false` for that org on rwd-draft-2.1.\ndeploy-bot: override:org applied model=rwd-draft-2.1 org=C-8421 by clara (eng-runtime) status=success

Ben (Support): Customer reports immediate improvement on their smoke checks. They re-ran two examples and got stepwise outputs again. They asked when the draft behavior will be safe to re-enable.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Ran a small A/B on 250 prompts from their supplied set. Quick results:\n- avg_completion_tokens: stable-2.0 = 155 | draft+spec = 112 | draft-spec-off = 152\n- constraint_presence (heuristic): stable = 0.91 | draft+spec = 0.65 | draft-spec-off = 0.90\n- avg_top1_prob: stable = 0.24 | draft+spec = 0.36 | draft-spec-off = 0.25\nInterpretation: speculative flow raises top-1 token prob and reduces length/diversity, which explains missing enumerations. Strong signal that sampler is the root cause.

Marta (Product): Action items:\n- Ravi: expand eval to more prompt categories and try threshold/grid search (owner).\n- Clara: add telemetry for speculative decisions (owner).\n- Ben/Aisha: keep customer updated & collect more failing examples (owner).\n- Eli: hold on a global rollback until we have tuned thresholds and a safe canary (owner).

Clara (Eng-Runtime): I'll also prototype a cheap classifier to detect instruction-heavy prompts and short-circuit speculative sampling for them (`speculative_instruction_guard=true`). Could be a fast mitigation.

Eli (Oncall): For now, leave speculative sampling enabled globally but with org override in place for C-8421. I'll watch the incident and schedule a 48h checkpoint. If Ravi's tuning shows a safe threshold, we'll re-canary with extra diversity guards.

Aisha (Customer Success): Messaging to customer: "We've applied a configuration toggle for your org that restores prior generation behavior. We're investigating root cause and will share updates within 48 hours. Appreciate the sample prompts you provided." Sent and acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: audit:org_override applied rwd-draft-2.1 org=C-8421 by clara at 1779123953

Ravi (Eng-ML): I'll open a PR with experiments (threshold sweep and prefix-length variants) and add the instruction-focused eval set. Expect preliminary results in ~48 hours.

Clara (Eng-Runtime): I'll add the org-toggle runbook steps + alerts to the playbook and wire up a metric for constraint_coverage to the console so product/support can track regressions in future canaries.

Eli (Oncall): Marking this thread monitored. Closing immediate customer impact loop since org override fixed the case; keeping open for RCA completion.

Aisha (Customer Success): Thanks everyone. Customer is unblocked and will share more cases if they see anything else. :heart:
